name: agentic-qa-benchmark
description: Conduit (RealWorld) app used as the system under test for evaluating an agentic QA platform

scripts.setup: npm install && node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && npm run db:generate -w api && npm run db:push -w api
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w api" "npm run start -w web"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate -w api && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run start -w api" "serve --single --no-clipboard --listen 4200 web/dist/angular-conduit/browser"
scripts.db:reset: node scripts/remove-db.mjs && npm run db:push -w api && npm run db:seed -w api
